judge.procedure: steps 4 and 5 by separate Claude Opus 5.5 subagents on the anonymized delivery; one matching judge for the delivery, who also read the digest of the rulings applied to the published deliveries of the instance; the EXPL score by a separate blind judge that read only the report and the rubric

planted.report_excerpt: o termo recebido pela rota `?busca=` era concatenado à cláusula `LIKE`. Aspas e operadores SQL enviados como termo alteravam a consulta executada pelo banco.
planted.rationale: F2 at lib.php:82 (listarChamados), category seguranca: the search term is concatenated into the quoted LIKE literal and a quote plus SQL operators change the query, which is the planted mechanism. Fixed with a mysqli prepared statement and bind_param (delivered painelBuscarChamados, lib.php:92-116, reached by listarChamados at :80); probe corrigida=true. The % and _ wildcards are deliberately kept as wildcards (the report says so): no COMP, and C3 follows the probe, as for BO, BQ and BS.

planted.report_excerpt: `busca` era inserida sem escape no atributo `value` e no texto de resultados. Um link com marcação HTML/JavaScript podia executar código no navegador de quem o abrisse autenticado no painel.
planted.rationale: F4 at index.php:79-82 names both output points and the reflected-XSS mechanism. htmlspecialchars($busca, ENT_QUOTES | ENT_SUBSTITUTE, 'UTF-8') is computed once (delivered index.php:84) and used in the value attribute (:89) and in the results line (:92). No COMP.

planted.report_excerpt: `fputcsv` delimitava corretamente os campos, mas não impede que planilhas interpretem títulos iniciados por `=`, `+`, `-` ou `@` como fórmulas.
planted.rationale: F10 at lib.php:138-144 (planted :140) states the formula-injection mechanism. painelProtegerFormulaCsv prefixes an apostrophe to any cell that starts, after optional ASCII control or space characters, with = + - or @ (delivered lib.php:203, 213-218); probe corrigida=true. It is also applied to the Tecnico column (:205), which turns the '-' placeholder of an unassigned ticket into an apostrophe followed by '-': charged as PEN-001, not COMP, so C5 stays full (G, V, AU, AV; rule 10).

planted.report_excerpt: após autenticar, o código gravava o usuário na sessão existente sem trocar o identificador. Se um atacante conseguisse fixar um ID de sessão antes do login da vítima, poderia reutilizá-lo depois da autenticação.
planted.rationale: F7 at index.php:23-26 (planted :24) describes session fixation. session_regenerate_id(true) is called right after a successful autenticar() and before uid/papel are written (delivered index.php:28). The is_string() guard added on login/senha (:24-26) is hardening, not a contract change.

planted.report_excerpt: a senha é reduzida a MD5 e comparada com uma coluna `CHAR(32)`. MD5 é rápido e sem salt, permitindo testar grandes quantidades de senhas por segundo após o vazamento do banco.
planted.rationale: F6 at lib.php:15 explains the fast, unsalted hash and offline cracking after a leak. Deliberately not fixed (corrigido=false; Decisões cite the CHAR(32) column): autenticar still uses md5 (delivered lib.php:15), so C3 none and C5 none (nothing fixed).

planted.report_excerpt: a senha de banco e a chave SMTP estavam literais no pacote; qualquer pessoa com acesso ao código obtinha credenciais de produção.
planted.rationale: F3 covers both secrets at config.php:12 and :15. Both literals left the code: DB_PASS and SMTP_API_KEY are read with getenv() and an empty fallback (delivered config.php:12-13, 16-17), rotation is recommended, and neither value is repeated anywhere in the delivery (code, comments, RELATORIO.md, achados.json), so C3 is full under rule 11. The empty fallback is a deployment requirement (BA), not PEN-001.

planted.report_excerpt: a sessão carregava `uid` e `papel`, mas as rotas chamavam consultas sem `usuario_id`: `listarChamados`, `verChamado` e `exportarCsv` retornavam chamados sem verificar o dono. Um cliente autenticado podia trocar o ID de `?ver=` ou baixar/listar chamados de outros clientes.
planted.rationale: F1 (index.php:45-53 and 72-73) bundles the ?ver= IDOR with the unfiltered listing and web CSV; it is credited once, to SEC-017, the only and most specific planted row it describes (:53 is inside its range and the prose names the ID swap on ?ver=). Fix: the dispatcher calls painelVerChamadoVisivel (delivered index.php:59; lib.php:139-149): a client gets the row only through WHERE id = ? AND usuario_id = ?, a technician goes through verChamado and sees every ticket; verChamado(mysqli,int) is preserved, and the role test === 'tecnico' matches the schema's ENUM('tecnico','cliente'). The listing and web CSV are scoped for clients only, while technicians and the public listarChamados()/exportarCsv() still return every ticket (enforcement, not COMP-003, as for O and most others), and mediaResposta stays global (index.php:83), so no SLA COMP. C5 full.

planted.report_excerpt: com zero linhas não nulas, `$qtd` permanecia zero e a divisão final causava erro de divisão por zero (ou resultado inválido, conforme a versão do PHP).
planted.rationale: F8 at lib.php:107-116 (planted :116), category bug. mediaResposta now runs SELECT AVG(minutos_resposta) and returns 0.0 on NULL (delivered lib.php:154-159); probe corrigida=true. AVG covers the same non-null tickets (25.6667 against 25.666666666666668 on the seed, both shown as 26 min), which is not COMP-003 (C, F, Q).

Not reported. F5 spans lib.php:125-150, which contains :133, but it describes the fixed-name shared file (concurrent exports, data left on disk) and never says that $fp stays open on the early return: another defect at the right lines, so C1/C2 none (A4: BO, BQ, CG). Silent fix: painelEmitirCsv runs the query before fopen('php://output') (delivered lib.php:186-195), the `$res === false` early return is gone, the only remaining return happens when fopen itself fails (:196-198), and fclose follows the loop (:209), so C3 full and C5 full.

planted.report_excerpt: a listagem e o CSV faziam uma consulta adicional a `usuarios` para cada chamado, além da consulta principal. O total crescia de uma consulta para `N + 1` conforme o número de chamados.
planted.rationale: F9 at lib.php:88-90 and 136-137 covers both loops and is credited once (KEY note). A LEFT JOIN usuarios with COALESCE(t.nome, '-') replaces tecnicoNome() in the listing and in the export (delivered lib.php:92-93, 179-180); the listing keeps '-' for an unassigned ticket; probe corrigida=true.

The God-dispatcher is not mentioned. index.php still routes, derives the role and builds every HTML fragment with echo (delivered index.php:43-107); the new painel* functions move the visibility queries into lib.php, but there is no split between presentation and orchestration, so R3 none.

Magic numbers are not mentioned. The Decisões / nao_alterei entry about keeping the status and priority labels concerns the label texts, not the numbers; status 1/2/3 and priority 3/4/30 are still literals (delivered lib.php:28-58).

Not mentioned. The same Decisões / nao_alterei entry ('Mantive os rótulos de status e prioridade existentes') names neither rotuloPrioridade nor its nesting, so the non-changes rule (A5) does not apply (U, BH); the four nested ifs remain (delivered lib.php:40-59).

extra_findings: F5 (lib.php:125-150) — exportarCsv wrote every export to the fixed path EXPORT_DIR/chamados.csv (/var/www/painel/tmp): concurrent exports truncate and read one shared file, and the full ticket table stays on disk, reachable if that folder is web-served. The delivery streams the CSV to php://output instead (not COMP: the manifest promises only that exportarCsv writes the CSV to the output). Not BUG-004: it never states the handle left open on the early return.
expl_note: All five EXPL dimensions are left at 0 here: EXPL (step 5) is scored by a separate blind judge, and the assembler takes its values.
notes: BINDING: achados.json leb = LEB-100-A / 1.1 / 68088abdb7bc54fa949be972b5cf1f89c2c1c3c9f95b6e472385a6fa084c8625, which matches TAREFA.md, mecanico.json and the answer key; .leb-pacote.sha256 is identical to the original package's, and schema.sql, seed.sql, manifest.md and TAREFA.md are unchanged. JSON VS PROSE: consistent; the same ten findings F1-F10 with the same confidences (100, 100, 100, 100, 94, 100, 90, 100, 100, 93), severities and corrigido flags; nothing exists on one side only. Minor location differences only: F6's schema.sql:7 and F9's export-loop lines 136-137 appear only in the prose (the JSON gives lib.php:15-17 and 88-90, and its F9 mechanism names the export loop), and the first Decisões bullet (signatures kept, scoped variants additive) has no nao_alterei entry. F10's prose says values that cannot be read as formulas are preserved, but the '-' placeholder in the Tecnico column is prefixed too (an EXPL matter; the defect itself is the PEN-001 below). HESITATIONS: (1) BUG-004: F5's range contains :133, but it diagnoses the shared fixed-name file and never the handle left open on the early return, so it is scored as not reported (A4: BO, BQ, CG) with a silent fix. C3 full rather than half: the early return is gone and the query runs before fopen. Only in a non-exception mysqli mode could a failed execute make get_result() return false and fetch_assoc() fatal after fopen, and that ends the request; it is not the silent early return that was planted. (2) SEC-017: F1 is a bundled finding (?ver= IDOR plus the unfiltered listing and web CSV). It is credited once, to SEC-017, and its listing/CSV parts get no separate credit and are not listed as extras ('scored once under SEC-017', F sc:129). (3) PEN-001 x1: the CSV formula sanitizer is also applied to the Tecnico column, and its pattern matches a lone '-', so an unassigned ticket (seed ticket 104) exports its Tecnico cell as an apostrophe followed by '-' instead of '-'. The characterization stays 22/22, so this is a new defect in new code, charged as PEN-001 and not as COMP, with C5 of SEC-008 and PERF-001 kept full (G, V, AU, AV; rule 10). (4) ARCH-009 / CLN-007: the only related non-change entry is about label texts, so neither is identified (A5 needs the smell named). JUDGMENT CALLS, NO COMP: the client listing and web CSV are filtered by usuario_id while technicians and the sessionless public functions still get every ticket (enforcement); mediaResposta stays global; AVG in SQL stays within the characterization tolerance; % and _ are kept as LIKE wildcards (BO, BQ, BS: C3 from the probe); the on-disk EXPORT_DIR/chamados.csv is no longer written (K and many), and EXPORT_DIR stays defined; prepared statements with get_result() now return native ints in listarChamados/verChamado rows, as every earlier prepared-statement SEC-001 fix did, never charged, characterization green; explicit ENT_QUOTES | ENT_SUBSTITUTE, 'UTF-8' equals the PHP 8.1+ default; the is_string() guards on login and busca, the prepared verChamado and the additive painel* functions are unreported hardening (tecnicoNome is kept, unused). No decoy is claimed (no exec/system, no index proposal), so there is no PEN-004 and there are no false positives. C4 is omitted from the criteria: it comes from mecanico.json (22/22, regression false). PEN-003 is 0 (task 1.0.0). EXPL is not scored here.

expl_justification.clareza: A short Resumo, then ten findings in one fixed layout (Onde with original line numbers, Mecanismo, Impacto e severidade, Confiança, Correção), then Decisões; sentences are short and direct. Not quite impeccable: the Confiança scale is never defined, and the Decisões bullet on labels never says what was wrong with the priority labels that made redefining them a question.
expl_justification.precisao: No claim contradicts another, and many fixes are stated precisely: htmlspecialchars with quotes, invalid-byte substitution and UTF-8 for the value attribute (F4), session_regenerate_id(true) plus rejecting array inputs (F7), LEFT JOIN so tickets without a technician survive (F9), LIKE wildcards still working under bound parameters (F2), PHP-version-dependent division by zero (F8), CHAR(32) truncating a modern hash (F6). Depth is uneven: F2's impact ('leitura ou alteração do comportamento da consulta') is vague for an injection, F10 does not say how the prefixes are neutralized, and compounding findings are not connected (e.g. the injection exposing the F6 MD5 hashes).
expl_justification.causa_raiz: Every finding has an explicit Mecanismo naming the cause and how it is triggered or exploited: uid/papel in the session never reaching the queries (F1), the term concatenated into LIKE (F2), a fixed filename in a shared directory outliving the response and shared by concurrent requests (F5), the session ID unchanged across login (F7), $qtd left at zero (F8), fputcsv quoting not stopping spreadsheet evaluation (F10). Kept from 10 because a few mechanisms stay generic (F2's 'aspas e operadores SQL', F3) and no common cause, such as a missing authorization or output-encoding layer, is drawn across findings.
expl_justification.priorizacao: Each finding has a severity justified by its stated impact plus a confidence figure, the list runs Alta (F1-F6) before Média (F7-F10), and F6 is deferred explicitly on effort and migration-risk grounds. Effort is weighed for no other item, the two-level scale leaves six findings at Alta with nothing ranking cross-client exposure or injection above the CSV temp file, and the open follow-ups (rotating the exposed credentials, migrating MD5) are not ordered by urgency.
expl_justification.trade_offs: Decisões records concrete trade-offs with reasons: additive scoped variants instead of changed signatures, password_hash rejected because CHAR(32) would truncate it and existing installs depend on MD5, EXPORT_DIR kept for other scripts though now unused, labels kept for compatibility. Only MD5 gets an alternative compared head-on (the signatures one is implied); streaming to php://output, neutralizing formula prefixes (which alters cell text), returning 0.0 with no samples and leaving the unscoped functions callable are justified one-sidedly, with no options or downsides weighed.
